Municipal galleries beside Plaza Regocijo shift the story from archaeological Cusco to modern and contemporary artists. Exhibitions change. Read the current exhibition title before treating a particular work as a permanent highlight.

Getting there

Walk from the historic centre to the address below. The last street can be pedestrian-only; give drivers the place name rather than just the district.

Get directions

History and local experience

Do not expect an archaeological survey in every Cusco museum. Here the exhibition text and artist statements help place present-day work in dialogue with a historic city.

Walking route

  1. Palacio Municipal, Plaza Regocijo, Cusco
  2. Cross Plaza Regocijo to the municipal entrance, ask which galleries are open and follow one exhibition from its introductory text to its final work.
  3. Return through the public courtyard.
